channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: DeSantis vetoes sovereign immunity bill that raised caps on government negligence payouts
item.description: Governor Ron DeSantis rejected legislation that would have increased damage caps for people harmed by government negligence for the first time in 16 years. item.title: S.D. Spady Elementary in Delray Beach jumps from C to A rating in state report card
item.description: Palm Beach County schools earned a third consecutive A rating from the state, with S.D. Spady Elementary School in Delray Beach making a dramatic leap from a C rating last year to an A this year.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4% this year, with ground beef and strawberries showing biggest increases
item.description: A holiday meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation attracts international artists to Fort Pierce with residency program
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is transforming Fort Pierce into an artistic destination, putting the Peacock Arts District on the map and connecting local and international artists through its residency program.

item.title: Port St. Lucie advances Florida Turnpike interchange at Midway Road as widening project continues
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation to assist with a partial interchange coming to the Florida Turnpike.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: The City of Riviera Beach was named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League and was the only Florida city selected for the honor this year.

item.title: St. Lucie County marine deputies rescue two boaters after vessel sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: Two boaters are safe after their vessel sank in the Intracoastal Waterway on Wednesday, July 1, thanks to a quick response from St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office Marine Unit deputies.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman dies in home fire as community raises funds for fiance
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home. Preliminary findings from the sheriff's office point to an electrical issue as a possible cause.

item.title: Anthem denies breast cancer reconstruction surgery hours before procedure for Treasure Coast patient
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, recently diagnosed with invasive ductal carcinoma, had her insurance company deny coverage for a reconstruction procedure less than 24 hours before it was scheduled.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock closes July 6 for $3 million renovation to nearly double slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a $3 million renovation projected to be complete by next Fourth of July. item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles match with Venus due to knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams withdrew from her doubles match with sister Venus at Wimbledon on Saturday due to a right knee injury.

item.title: Saint Andrew's Scots football eyes state title run after 10-2 season and district championship
item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots are setting their sights on a state title as they prepare for the 2026 fall football season following a 10-2 record and district championship last year. item.description: Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach is offering educational and interactive programs during peak sea turtle nesting season through September. item.title: North Palm Beach Country Club Hosts Fourth of July Fireworks and Pool Party
item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors celebrated Independence Day with a full day of family-friendly activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse on July 4.

item.title: Secretary of State Cord Byrd seeks to keep Paula Stark off ballot after filing deadline dispute
item.description: Five state employees dispute St. Cloud Republican Paula Stark's account of a paperwork mix-up that left her disqualified from the ballot less than 30 minutes before the June 12 deadline.

item.title: United States men's soccer team faces Belgium in World Cup knockout round Monday
item.description: The U.S. team earned its first knockout stage victory since 2002 with a 2-0 win over Bosnia and Herzegovina on Wednesday, but will be without Folarin Balogun against Belgium after a red card.

item.title: Supreme Court ruling allows absentee ballots postmarked by Election Day to count if received later
item.description: The Supreme Court ruled 5-4 that states may count absentee ballots postmarked by Election Day but received afterward, preserving grace period laws that election officials depend on.
